title: CUDA-Ising-Osteo: a reproducible GPU Ising/QUBO pipeline for genetics-anchored gene-target discovery in osteoporosis
description: Open-source, GPU-accelerated Ising/QUBO (batched parallel-tempering) solver and fully reproducible pipeline accompanying the article 'Genetics-anchored network optimisation prioritises druggable WNT-pathway targets for osteoporosis, while monocyte expression signatures fail to replicate: a reproducible GPU Ising/QUBO pipeline'. The repository contains the solver, the two target-discovery formulations (expression-based QUBO feature selection and GWAS-seeded STRING network-module optimisation), the cross-cohort replication protocol, the edge-term ablation and solver-robustness analyses, the orthogonal-validation retrieval scripts, derived matrices, the curated 56-gene seed list, configuration files, candidate tables and figure-generation code. Primary data sources: NCBI GEO series GSE56815, GSE56814 and GSE7158; STRING v12.0 (Homo sapiens, taxon 9606); the Open Targets Platform. Released under the MIT licence.
